_collection.text: Only needs to double from here to get to a reasonable value

Alibaba's technical analysis pointing to an oversold territory and likely to rebound back to HK$120 level in the next 2-3 weeks before testing higher to HK$132 with resistance at HK$150. Alibaba's last quarter net profit (ending 31 Mar 2026) was HK$25.54 billion & annual net profit (ending 31 Mar 2026) was HK$103.59 billion. It is still a very profitable company with reasonable P/E, P/B and Debt/Equity.

Alibaba is undervalued. Analysts' average target price is HK$180+. Q1 2026 net profit is still looking very good at HK$25.541 billion. Should see Alibaba going back to HK$120 by 31 Jul 2026 before going higher.

Alibaba’s Quark S1 AI glasses are super and can translate 89 languages in realtime - but the user interface is Chinese only and can’t even switch to English. So in my eyes their understanding is A for Artificial and I stands for Ignorance. I bought the Quark S1 glasses but sold all my Alibaba shares upon this experience.  I don’t understand there thinking behind such decissions. Sure, the first batch is ment for the domestic market, BUT there are so many older expats like me in China, who can speak fluent but can not read Chinese characters.  After contributing much to development of the country it hurts being ignored by companies like Alibaba.
Insane trend, amazing news comes every single day...

profile.description: Alibaba Group Holding Limited, through its subsidiaries, provides technology infrastructure and marketing reach to help merchants, brands, retailers, and other businesses in the People's Republic of China and internationally. It operates through the Alibaba China E-Commerce Group, Alibaba International Digital Commerce Group, Cloud Intelligence Group, and All Others segments. The Alibaba China E-commerce Group segment operates Taobao and Tmall, which are digital retail platforms; Taobao Instant Commerce, a local services and on-demand delivery platform; 1688.com, a domestic wholesale marketplace; and Xianyu, a consumer-to-consumer community and marketplace for idle goods. Its Alibaba International Digital Commerce Group segment includes AliExpress, a global e-commerce platform; Trendyol, an e-commerce platform in Turkey; Lazada, an e-commerce platform in Southeast Asia; Daraz, an e-commerce platform in South Asia, primarily in Pakistan and Bangladesh; and Alibaba.com, an integrated international online wholesale marketplace. The Cloud Intelligence Group segment offers a suite of cloud services based on infrastructure-as-a-service, platform-as-a-service, and model-as-a-service. Its All Others segment comprises Amap, a provider of mobile digital maps, navigation, and real-time traffic information in China; Cainiao, which provides logistics solutions; Youku, an online long-form video platform in China; Freshippo, a retail platform for groceries and fresh goods; and Alibaba Health, a pharmaceutical and healthcare services platform. Alibaba Group Holding Limited was incorporated in 1999 and is based in Hangzhou, China.
